statement: Full-throttle static thrust measured on a scale is at least 3x the all-up weight
note: Props on, quad strapped upside down to a kitchen scale (thrust pushes down). Betaflight Motors tab, all four together at 100% for 2 s. Record grams, divide by the AUW from the scale. Pass: >= 3.0. Replaces A1, A5, A6.
rationale: Settles C1 on hardware instead of on three assumptions.
